window-1.title: Koalas to the Max
window-1.blurb: Drag to split one big dot into thousands until a hidden picture emerges — and then feed it your own image so your friends have to slowly unpick a photo of your grandma, dot by dot.

window-2.title: Colossal
window-2.blurb: It's a daily drip of people who went way too far on a handmade idea — thread portraits, stop-motion obsessives, clay worlds — and you'll come away with three new side quests before lunch.

window-3.title: Calamansi Sparkling Margarita Mocktail
window-3.blurb: A margarita rerouted through calamansi — that auntie-kitchen citrus you already know by heart — salted rim and all, and endlessly riffable with a chilli-salt rim or a float of pandan syrup.

window-4.title: Tour a Family of Four's Maximalist East Harlem Apartment
window-4.blurb: This is a rental absolutely crammed with color and collected junk-with-soul, and it'll give you permission to stop leaving empty walls and just hang the thing.
